title: spathulata spuria
intro: Spathulata spuria, commonly known as Desert Marigold, is a flowering plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The health benefits of Desert Marigold include its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its calming and soothing effects, which are believed to be caused by its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects and potential uses of Spathulata spuria.
